label: Baseline
hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.

proposer.name: Codex
proposer.attribution: Authored by Codex while building this demo, with public access to all scenarios; no runtime provider call.

label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Enabling entity and temporal pre-filters will prevent cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested as-of interval, improving complete-scenario task success and reducing stale or distracting retrieval without changing writes or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor cases should return the requested subject; historical-address, future-move, and history-boundary cases should select the valid as-of record. Relevant-memory recall and stale-fact rate should improve, with no expected impact on owner isolation, deletion semantics, or write precision.

label: Agent proposal 3
hypothesis: Enabling deduplication will reuse identical active values during repeated confirmations, preserving retrieval correctness while reducing unnecessary historical records and storage.
predicted_effect: The duplicate-confirmation scenario should retain the German answer while producing fewer records. Complete-scenario success should remain at least as high as the current 0.95, with no expected change to owner isolation, deletion, write admission, or confidence behavior.
